scope: All public methods in the Windows 0.62.2 Rust projection for the twelve explicitly listed external classes. Getters/setters count separately. The control_role distinguishes methods directly invoked by the pinned WinUI source from additional public dependency APIs, portable engine support, and optional extensions. This is not the entire Windows.UI.Input.Inking namespace.

members.name: CopySelectedToClipboard
members.notes: Real Windows CI run 39605086703/job119239093640 at 7fbffd0 passes the dedicated STA copy/can-paste/paste fixture, comparing native getter state, attributes, transformed samples and fresh IDs. The adapter preserves OS selection. The public FerroUI container deliberately selects newly pasted clones and clears the old selection, matching the published Learn contract and portable paste; the installed native reference instead retains old=true and returns new=false. STA is required and checked explicitly.

members.name: LoadAsync
members.notes: Portable bounded FERROINK futures and optional genuine Windows ISF/GIF calls. Windows CI run39600257242/job119222654079 at353c692 passes native attribute/transform conversion, both format round trips, malformed-load atomicity and explicit twist-loss policy. Native f32/ISF quantization and fresh import IDs are documented adaptations; Rust save_async defaults to Portable, with GifWithEmbeddedIsf requested explicitly.

control_role_definitions.required_by_controls: An invocation exists in the pinned WinUI control implementation; upstream_references identifies its file. This contributes to the required control completion gate.
control_role_definitions.returned_service_api: Additional method on a Windows object exposed by the WinUI surface, or a nested value type. Missing members limit broader dependency API parity but are not direct control implementation calls.
control_role_definitions.portable_engine_support: Value or builder API used to replace external OS stroke creation in the portable engine, beyond the WinUI wrapper source.
control_role_definitions.optional_extension: Adjacent native capability or nested advanced OS API that the pinned controls neither invoke nor require. Its missing implementation is not a WinUI control completion prerequisite.
